verdict.rationale: As a Python library, Pydantic AI runs headlessly by design. Agents can be called as a plain object via run() or placed on a durable background queue. For CI-style automation, the docs offer TestModel/FunctionModel for mocking LLMs and code-first evals that run from your own code, which community users also corroborate. Missing for 10: explicit CI pipeline documentation or examples, a documented non-interactive/scripted mode for the `clai` CLI, and independent hands-on reports of running in CI.
